description: Example query set for dataset/curated_metrics_like.json that exercises conditions on list attributes: name[*].attr (any entry matches), name[i].attr (a given entry matches) and count(name) (number of entries). Every query returns the flat (node-level) columns, so a result is the set of sample records satisfying the condition. 'match' states the question once, independent of any backend; 'query' gives its text per backend or dialect, and a query with no text for a backend is skipped for it. Run it with DATASET=dataset/curated_metrics_like.json and QUERY_FILE=queries/curated_metrics.json.

queries.name: nodes with any cpu below an idle threshold (name[*].attr, existential)

query.influxdb: SELECT DISTINCT n.component_id AS component_id, n.job_id AS job_id, n.seq AS seq, n.timestamp AS timestamp FROM {schema} n JOIN {schema}_cpu c ON n.component_id = c.component_id AND n.timestamp = c.timestamp WHERE c.idle < 50 ORDER BY n.timestamp
query.dsos: select component_id, job_id, seq, timestamp from {schema}_cpu where idle < 50 order_by timestamp

queries.name: nodes whose cpu[0] is below an idle threshold (name[i].attr, indexed)

query.influxdb: SELECT DISTINCT n.component_id AS component_id, n.job_id AS job_id, n.seq AS seq, n.timestamp AS timestamp FROM {schema} n JOIN {schema}_cpu c ON n.component_id = c.component_id AND n.timestamp = c.timestamp WHERE c.entry_index = 0 AND c.idle < 50 ORDER BY n.timestamp
query.dsos: select component_id, job_id, seq, timestamp from {schema}_cpu where entry_index == 0 and idle < 50 order_by timestamp

queries.name: nodes with at least 3 network interfaces (count(name))

query.influxdb: SELECT n.component_id AS component_id, n.job_id AS job_id, n.seq AS seq, n.timestamp AS timestamp FROM {schema} n JOIN (SELECT component_id, timestamp, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM {schema}_netdev GROUP BY component_id, timestamp) c ON n.component_id = c.component_id AND n.timestamp = c.timestamp WHERE c.cnt >= 3 ORDER BY n.timestamp
